data.name: Varu
data.gender_notes: Varu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Varu is the name of a goddess who is the personification of fertility, prosperity, and joy. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. The name Varu carries the meaning “Goddess of fertility” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Varu usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Varu represents the divine feminine energy of creation and abundance. She is the goddess of fertility, and her blessings bring prosperity, joy, and abundance in all areas of life.
data.etymology: Varu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of fertility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Varu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
